text: Figure 2.24: Multi-Core-Type II Driver Example All code of the driver is generally allocated with GLOBAL scope: • XXX_Init() - XXX_SEC_CODE_... • XXX_DeInit() - XXX_SEC_CODE_... • XXX_Trigger() - XXX_SEC_CODE_... • XXX_Get() - XXX_SEC_CODE_... • XXX_Set() - XXX_SEC_CODE_... The Pointer to the active data instance is also allocated with GLOBAL scope: • XXX_ActiveData - XXX_SEC_VAR_INIT_CLONE_... Instead the core individual data (this can be also constants) are allocated with LOCAL scope and shall be accessed on the core these are allocated only . • XXX_CORE1_Data - XXX_CORE1_SEC_VAR_INIT_..._LOCAL_... • XXX_CORE2_Data - XXX_CORE2_SEC_VAR_INIT_..._LOCAL_... Please note that the shown example is design and hardware specific and requires the support of the cloning capability .
